description: This PHP class 'FormatWithJobTitle' implements a value formatting strategy that retrieves a job title name based on an entity value (likely an ID). It uses a service class 'JobTitleService' to fetch the job title entity and returns its name if found.

classes.name: FormatWithJobTitle
classes.description: A class implementing a value formatter to fetch job title names based on entity IDs.

methods.name: getJobTitleService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns an instance of JobTitleService.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Retrieves the job title name corresponding to the provided entity value (ID).
